description_en: Disconnects a connected instance or disassociates an instance that is associated with another user
description_zh: 将处于连接中的实例断开连接，或将被其他用户绑定的实例进行解绑
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic disconnect-android-instance --instance-ids acp-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --end-user-id user1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisconnectAndroidInstance

parameters.help_en: A list of instance IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，可设置 1~100 个
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">

If you use the Cloud Phone Matrix Edition and the instance stream pattern is collaborative mode, you can specify `EndUserId` to disconnect a specific user and invalidate the corresponding ticket.

</props>

<props="intl">

This parameter is not publicly available.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">如果使用的是云手机矩阵版，并且实例串流模式为协同模式，则可以通过指定`EndUserId`的方式断开指定用户的连接，并且令相应的Ticket失效。</props>

<props="intl">本参数暂不对外开放使用。</props>
parameters.name: end_user_id
